claim.anchor: Coorong lagoon system (South Australia) and Persian Gulf sabkhas. The classic natural laboratory for direct-from-solution dolomite formation per Kim, Sun et al. 2023 (Science 382:915).
claim.description: Cycling-brine sabkha producing ORDERED dolomite at ambient T via the Kim 2023 mechanism. Twelve flood/evap pulses over 240 steps drive Ω across the dolomite saturation boundary repeatedly — the cyclic Ω modulation that's needed to produce ordered dolomite at surface T.

deterministic.reason: A plausible high-Mg shallow-brine CaCO3 polymorph during the sabkha flood/evaporation cycles.
A common carbonate competitor in sabkha pore fluids and the limestone substrate.
A minor Sr-sulfate evaporite accessory permitted by the concentrated marine-derived brine.

Disordered high-Mg calcite is the expected metastable cement/precursor during measured-domain marine-brine intervals before repeated dissolution-precipitation cycles order part of the Ca-Mg carbonate inventory as dolomite.

claim_citations.statement: High-Mg calcite is admitted only where the measured parent-fluid partition domain resolves a 4-30 mol% Mg shell; every accepted shell records its actual Ca-Mg formula and nonideal solid-solution assessment.
sources: Mucci & Morse 1983, Geochimica et Cosmochimica Acta 47:217-233
Bischoff, Mackenzie & Bishop 1987, Geochimica et Cosmochimica Acta 51:1413-1423

claim_citations.statement: Repeated dissolution-precipitation cycling can remove kinetic defects and permit low-temperature ordered dolomite growth; the scenario records HMC and dolomite as distinct layered products rather than silently treating one as the other.
sources: Kim, Sun et al. 2023, Science 382:915-920, doi:10.1126/science.adi3690

notes: Surface T (~25°C), high-Mg evaporative brine, seasonal flood-evaporate cycles. Per Kim, Sun et al. (2023, Science 382:915), exactly this kind of cyclic Ω modulation is what's needed to produce ordered dolomite at ambient T.

The acid-pulse-and-relax style of reactive_wall produces only DISORDERED HMC because the dissolution events are too aggressive (full dissolution rather than gentle surface etch). Sabkha tidal pumping is the right kind of cycling — gentle, frequent, repeated.

Twelve flood/evap pairs over 240 steps produce ~12 dissolution-precipitation cycles. With N0=10 in the f_ord formula, this reaches ORDERED (f_ord > 0.7) by mid-scenario. The result: true ordered dolomite, the geological prize the Kim 2023 paper made accessible.

Schema note: the original Python/JS implementations used factory functions `make_flood(idx)` and `make_evap(idx)` to bake the cycle index into each handler's narrator string. Per the Phase 2 migration, we use one flood handler and one evap handler reused across all 12 cycles (the supergene_acidification precedent — same handler, multiple Event entries pointing to it). Cycle number is preserved via the event `name` field ('Tidal Flood #1', 'Evaporation #1', etc.) instead of an in-handler f-string.
